verses.text: Of David. A thoughtful psalm. Happy is the person whose wrongdoing is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
Happy is the person whom the LORD does not count as guilty, whose spirit has no lies in it.
When I kept quiet about my sin, my body wasted away because I groaned all day long.
Day and night your hand pressed down on me. My strength dried up as in the heat of summer. Selah.
Then I admitted my sin to you. I did not hide my wrongdoing. I said, "I will confess my sins to the LORD," and you forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah.
So let all your faithful people pray to you while they can still find you. Then when the great floodwaters rise, they will not reach them.
You are my hiding place. You protect me from trouble. You surround me with songs of rescue. Selah.
I will teach you and show you the way you should go. I will guide you and keep my eye on you.
Do not be like a horse or a mule, which have no understanding. They must be controlled with bits and bridles, or they will not come to you.
Wicked people have many sorrows, but the LORD's faithful love surrounds those who trust in him.
Be glad in the LORD and celebrate, you who do what is right! Shout for joy, all you whose hearts are honest!
